title: EU REX number checker
description: Checks EU Registered Exporter (REX) numbers against the European Commission's public REX database, one or up to ten at a time, returning status, registration date, exporter name and country. No API key is needed. Free online version: trishaktiapparel.com/tools/rex-checker/. Made by Trishakti Apparel, a knitwear factory in Gaindakot, Nepal.
